description: This file is an Angular component ('ImeAdditionalPropertiesComponent') that renders a detailed UI view for displaying various IME (Input Method Editor) and window management properties, including WM State, focus, visibility, and specific IME-related parameters. It contains HTML template, styles, and TypeScript logic for handling user interactions, highlighting items, and accessing nested properties related to IME additional properties within a larger codebase.

classes.name: ImeAdditionalPropertiesComponent
classes.description: An Angular component class responsible for rendering and managing user interaction with IME and window properties visualization.

methods.name: isHighlighted
methods.description: Checks if a given item is highlighted based on the highlightedItems array.

methods.name: formatProto
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed version of a given item if available.

methods.name: wmProtoOrNull
methods.description: Gets the 'proto' property from the additionalProperties.wm object, if available.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderOrNull
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ImeInsetsSourceProvider object if protoImeInsetsSourceProvider exists.

methods.name: wmControlTargetFrameOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the window frame of control target if available.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderPositionOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the position of the IME Insets Source Provider if available.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderIsLeashReadyOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the 'isLeashReadyForDispatching' property from the IME Insets Source Provider.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderControllableOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the 'controllable' status from the IME Insets Source Provider.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderSourceFrameOrNull
methods.description: Gets the source frame from the source provider if available.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderSourceVisibleOrNull
methods.description: Gets the source visibility status.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderSourceVisibleFrameOrNull
methods.description: Gets the visible frame of the source if available.

methods.name: wmImeControlTargetOrNull
methods.description: Returns the IME control target object if present.

methods.name: wmImeControlTargetTitleOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the title from the IME control target window container.

methods.name: wmImeInputTargetOrNull
methods.description: Returns the IME input target object if available.

methods.name: wmImeInputTargetTitleOrNull
methods.description: Gets the title from the IME input target window container.

methods.name: wmImeLayeringTargetOrNull
methods.description: Returns the IME layering target object if present.

methods.name: wmImeLayeringTargetTitleOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the title from the IME layering target window container.

methods.name: sfImeContainerScreenBoundsOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the screen bounds of the IME container.

methods.name: sfImeContainerRectOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the rect of the IME container.

methods.name: isAllPropertiesNull
methods.description: Determines if all relevant IME or window properties are null to decide if content should be displayed.

methods.name: onClickShowInPropertiesPanel
methods.description: Handles user click to dispatch events for highlighting or selecting properties.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Dispatches an event to highlight an item by its ID.

methods.name: updateAdditionalPropertySelected
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating an additional property has been selected, including its wrapper info.
